title: Every matching is obtained from its core by successive insertions of short chords
author: Avichai Marmor
work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `lem:matching is generated by inserts to its core` at source lines 1190-1196: a matching with k unstable chords can be written as the result of k successive insertions of short chords applied to its core. The author's proof (source lines 1198-1202) is an induction in which the two structural facts about the core and about insertions have to be combined correctly: the induction step removes one short chord (i_1,i_1+1), which requires knowing that an unstable matching contains a short chord, and then uses that removing a chord leaves the core unchanged so that the smaller matching has exactly k-1 unstable chords (line 1201). Only then can the induction hypothesis be applied to that smaller matching and the insertion prepended. The statement is a single sentence about a product of insertions and gives no hint that the core has to be tracked through the deletion.
